$description: howl design tokens — theme 'Midnight Fjord'. Single source of truth. tokens.css is generated from this file by scripts/build-tokens.mjs; never edit tokens.css by hand. Every value used in the app must come from a token.

night.use: App background. The default ground of every screen.

sunken.use: Wells: the tune roll, text fields.

control.use: Resting pads, chips, secondary buttons, selected rail item, active lyric line.

default.use: Outlined buttons, dashed empty states, input borders.

strong.use: Focused-but-not-selected outlines, beat grid bar lines.

primary.use: Her words, headings, labels. Contrast 17.3:1 on night.

secondary.use: Supporting labels, inactive rail labels, hints. 10.8:1.

tertiary.use: Least important readable text (timecodes, 'next' syllables). 6.4:1 — the floor for any text.

onAccent.use: Text and icons on aurora or moonlight fills.

decorative.use: NOT for text. Plus signs in empty cells, drag handles, placeholder icons only.

aurora.use: THE primary colour. One primary action per screen, her tune notes, the 'now' syllable, playhead, recording.

auroraSoft.use: Tinted background behind the glowing syllable.

auroraGlow.use: box-shadow glow colour for pressed pads, record button, playhead.

green.use: Ideas / help from the app (always optional), and the Backing layer. Never used for primary actions.

moonlight.use: Secondary filled button (e.g. 'Hear it', 'Share'), the Voice layer.

words.use: Song map cells for Words (with text).

auroraGlowField.value: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(255,91,168,0.22) 0%, rgba(142,240,198,0.06) 40%, rgba(7,9,13,0) 70%)
auroraGlowField.use: The one ambient glow per screen. Blurred 40px, behind content, never behind body text at more than 0.25 alpha.

ui.use: Everything she reads: UI, lyrics, labels. Designed to reduce visual stress for dyslexic readers.

display.use: Screen titles and song names only, always italic, weight 300. Never for instructions.

displayL.use: Screen title inside the studio ('Chorus tune').

displayM.use: Song name in the top bar, song name on covers.

lyricL.use: The current line on the Tune screen.

lyricM.use: Lyric lines in Write / Say it all.

lyricS.use: Lyric lines in lists (Sort your lines).

heading.use: Section labels ('Sounds', 'Chords'). Sentence case. Never all caps.

caption.use: Rail labels, timecodes, meta. 14px is the minimum size for any text.

noteLabel.use: Syllable text inside a note block ONLY (it duplicates the big lyric line above, so it may be smaller).

rules: Sentence case everywhere. No ALL CAPS, no tracked uppercase labels.
No italic for Lexend. Italic is reserved for Fraunces display titles.
Max line length for instructions: 60 characters.

touchMin.use: Minimum hit area for anything she taps. 44 only for secondary chips inside dense panels.

elevation.rule: No drop shadows. Depth comes from surface colour steps (night → sunken → raised → control). Glow is the only shadow and it means 'alive / sounding / now'.

instant.use: Pad press visual. Must feel simultaneous with sound.

quick.use: Hover/press states, chip select, syllable hand-off.

spring.use: Small playful pops: note block landing, syllable glow arriving. Max overshoot 6%.

rules: Motion follows sound. Anything that makes a sound animates on the same frame the sound starts.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: keep colour/opacity changes, drop scale, translate and breathing.
Nothing loops forever except: the playhead while playing, breathing on the record button while recording, breathing on the waiting syllable.
Never animate layout of her words while she is reading them.
